snippet.title: Go Vacation - Official E3 Trailer
snippet.description: Explore A Fun-Filled Island Paradise! Welcome to Kawawii Island, a paradise vacation destination with dozens of exciting activities for the entire family! Check in from the comfort of your own home and explore the island at your own pace, taking in the snow, sun, city, beach, and more, all on one island. The ultimate vacation arrives this fall for the Nintendo Wii!
